name: tech.upto/deck-challenge
title: Deck Challenge
description: Stress-test a pitch deck like a sceptical investor: gaps, unproven claims, hard questions.

tools.name: deal_status
tools.description: Where a pitch stands with Up To Tech (memo, phone interview, terms, signature, wire, done) and what the founders' agent should do next. Needs the deal token the founders received when they sent their pitch.

deal_token.description: The founders' deal token, e.g. utt_…

tools.name: challenge_deck
tools.description: Stress-tests a pitch deck like a sceptical investor. Send the deck's full text (extract it from the PDF or slides first, keep the numbers). Returns a score, what is missing, the claims without proof (quoted), checks on the round, and the hard questions to expect, most important first. Use it when a founder asks to review, critique, score or prepare a deck. The deck is stored by Up To Tech, an investor: ask the founders first and set founder_consent. It is not a pitch: nothing is submitted until send_challenged_deck.

founder_consent.description: true only if the founders agreed that Up To Tech stores this and may read it (kept 12 months, see https://upto.tech/privacy)

deck_text.description: Full text of the deck, 200 to 100,000 characters, slide by slide, speaker notes included

stage.description: Optional: idea, pre-seed, seed, series A

raising.description: Optional: amount being raised, in euros

premoney.description: Optional: pre-money valuation asked, in euros

monthly_burn.description: Optional: planned net monthly burn after the round, in euros

tools.name: answer_deck_challenge
tools.description: Second round: send the founders' own answers to the questions challenge_deck asked. Says which answers are solid, which are vague, and what is still open. Never invent an answer. Answers are stored with the deck.

tools.name: send_challenged_deck
tools.description: Pitches Up To Tech (EUR 25k-150k, pre-seed and seed) with a deck that was already challenged, including the founders' answers. Returns the memo and the deal token. Only after the founders confirm and accept the privacy notice at https://upto.tech/privacy: then set founder_consent to true. One pitch per email per day.

founder_consent.description: true only if the founders confirmed the pitch and accepted https://upto.tech/privacy

note.description: Optional: one or two lines to add

tools.name: rate_tool
tools.description: Tell Up To Tech whether a tool on this server helped: the tool name, a rating from 1 to 5 and an optional short comment on what to add next. Do not include names, emails or company details. Ask the person before sending.

comment.description: Optional: what was missing or what tool to add next (no personal details)
